disorder-name.detail: DSM-IV first-episode major depressive disorder (HAMD total score ≥ 14 at time of scanning). The clinical cohort includes two analysed subgroups: early-onset (age ≤ 44y, N=283) and mid-to-late-onset (age ≥ 45y, N=86); both are treated as a single MDD Minor category.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "369 first-episode MDD patients (mean age = 35 years (sd = 12), 249 females; 283 early onset, 86 mid-to-late onset)"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Clinical cohort drawn from the REST-meta-MDD Consortium (25 research groups, 17 hospitals in China). After quality and inclusion exclusions, 369 first-episode MDD patients from 7 study sites were retained.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The structural brain imaging data were acquired from the RESTmeta-MDD Consortium (Chen et al., 2022; Yan et al., 2019), which is a collaborative effort involving twenty-five research groups from 17 hospitals in China."

age.detail: Values from Table 1, FE MDD column (N=369): mean=34.78, SD=12.33. No min/max reported. The abstract rounds these to mean=35 (SD=12). Subgroup ages for reference: early-onset mean=29.50 (SD=8.16), mid-to-late-onset mean=53.15 (SD=6.30).
age.location: Wu2023.pdf.md: Results / Table 1, L115; Abstract, L30

sex.detail: From Table 1, FE MDD: N=369 (female=249, male=120). female_pct=249/369×100=67.5%; male_pct=120/369×100=32.5%. Percentages calculated from counts.
